description:
Returns the user's career journal entries from GigHQ, newest first. Supports optional filtering by entry type, date range, tags, and keyword, plus a compact list mode that omits full text.

Use this tool to:
  - Review what the user has already documented before starting a journaling session
  - Find entries to update or refine
  - Identify gaps (roles with few or no entries)
  - Scan titles, tags, and metrics in compact mode before opening a full entry
  - Synthesise entries into resume bullets or interview stories

Entry type filter values: 1=achievement, 2=project, 3=skill_acquired, 4=reflection.
When `tags` or `query` is set, the GigHQ API applies those filters and `take` and `skip` paginate the matches. If the API can't (an older backend), this tool scans the journal in pages (up to 1,000 entries) and filters them itself; `scan_truncated` is set if the scan hit that cap.

compact.description: If true, return the compact list (same as fields='compact'): uuid, title, type, entry_date, experience_id, tags, and metrics, with no description.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 end date to filter entries on or before, e.g. '2024-12-31'.

fields.description: Response shape. 'compact' returns uuid, title, type, entry_date, experience_id, tags, and metrics, and omits description, role, and company. Same as compact=true. Default is 'full'.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword search over title, description, metrics, and tags. Every whitespace-separated term must appear as a substring in that combined text.

skip.description: Number of entries to skip for pagination. When tags or query is set, this applies after those filters.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 start date to filter entries on or after, e.g. '2024-01-01'.

tags.description: Filter by tag tokens. Accepts a comma-separated string or an array. Matching is case-insensitive and exact on each comma-separated tag token (so 'leadership' does not match the tag 'people leadership'). Combine with tags_match.

tags_match.description: When tags is set, 'any' (default) returns entries that have at least one of the requested tags; 'all' requires every requested tag.

take.description: Number of entries to return (default 25, max 100). When tags or query is set, this applies after those filters.

type.description: Filter by entry type: 1=achievement, 2=project, 3=skill_acquired, 4=reflection. Omit for all types.

name: list_career_entries
